fusions.name: Wild Combers
fusions.desc: Drives a gallop of breaking waves 6 tiles ahead, dealing 30 damage to everything caught in it and ignoring their resistances.

fusions.name: Galloping Breaker
fusions.desc: Rushes you to a target up to 7 tiles away on a breaking wave, then deals 14 damage and leaves it 12% easier to wound for 5 seconds.

fusions.name: Surf Steeds
fusions.desc: Takes 0.5 seconds to call a steed of surf that fights beside you for 12 seconds, striking for 5 damage every 1.4 seconds.

fusions.name: Bow Wave
fusions.desc: Every 6 tiles you cover, a wave of water shields you for 10% of your maximum health for 4 seconds. Once every 12 seconds.
